description: Checks one capability against CANOPY's published facts, overall or at one location: e.g. 24/7 access, private VLAN, wired internet, parking, boardroom, event space, phone booths, dogs, showers, team size. Answers yes, no, location_dependent or ask_team (CANOPY doesn't publish it: CANOPY's team confirms; never assume yes), with each location's answer and the page it comes from. No contact details needed.
name: get_canopy_capabilities
title: Can CANOPY do this? (capabilities)
